'''Energy suppression fields''' were fields of energy which blocked or limited the amount of damage inflicted by a weapon upon an individual. These devices were employed by the [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] [[Taris dueling ring|dueling ring]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]] after the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] outlawed [[Death/Legends|death]] matches. The fields most often prevented the individuals from dying during the arena combat, but they did not prevent the duelists from sustaining serious injuries or being rendered unconscious.
